extracted.intended_audience: policy makers, patent office officials, IP statisticians, researchers and stakeholders analyzing Russian IP system statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction and interpretation of statistical indicators and metrics from Rospatent's annual report (tables on patents, utility models, trademarks, industrial designs, services, decisions, audits, and related IP administration activity for 2015–2019).

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of granted patents (by Federal district)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of granted patents in 2019 in the Federal districts of the Russian Federation (counts per district and % of the whole number of patents granted by the Russian applicant).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table shows absolute counts per federal district and percentage share of patents granted to Russian applicants; used to analyze geographic distribution of patent grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications by foreign citizens (top 15 countries)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of applications filed in 2019 by foreign citizens from the 15 countries with the highest number of applications, with breakdowns 'including entities' and 'including individuals'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table lists per-country total applications and subcounts for legal entities versus individuals; supports analysis of foreign applicant composition by country and entity type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of granted patents by CPC Section (annual)
rubrics_metrics.description: Dynamics (2015–2019) of granted patents in the Russian Federation distributed by CPC Sections A–H (counts per section per year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables tracking of technological field trends across years using CPC section aggregation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Granted patents by foreign applicants (top countries)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of patents granted in 2019 to foreign applicants from the 15 countries with the highest numbers (per-country counts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies countries whose nationals obtained most grants in Russia in the year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total applications filed to Rospatent (annual)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of applications filed to Rospatent per year (2015–2019) including breakdowns under national and international procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes year-over-year percentage change and allows separation between national filings and international (e.g., Hague/Geneva Act) filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under national procedure (annual)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of applications filed under the national procedure each year and breakdown between Russian applicants and foreign applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compare domestic vs foreign filing volumes under national route.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under international procedure (Hague / Geneva Act)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of applications filed under the international procedure (e.g., Hague Agreement / Geneva Act) per year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows uptake of international filing routes affecting Russian filings/consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications considered at stage of examination (annual)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of applications considered on the stage of examination per year and related decisions made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to assess examination workload and throughput.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions on granting (annual) with applicant nationality split
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of decisions to grant patents each year, with breakdown showing grants to Russian applicants and grants to foreign applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks how many grants are awarded and to whom (domestic vs foreign).

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions of rejection (annual) with applicant nationality split
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of decisions to reject applications each year, with counts for Russian and foreign applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of examination outcomes and potential barriers for certain applicant groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions to accept withdrawal (annual) with nationality split
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of decisions to accept an application withdrawal per year, separated for Russian and foreign applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures voluntary termination/withdrawal activity and nationality patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total international utility models applications considered (annual)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total of all international utility models applications considered per year and year-on-year percent change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitors international utility model workload and trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dynamics of Russian granted patents (annual totals and % change)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts of granted patents in Russia (2015–2019), with 2019 % change relative to 2018 and breakdown to Russian and foreign applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level metric of grant volume and growth/decline trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of valid patents as of date
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of patents valid as of 31.12 of a given year, plus patents granted in the year and patents terminated in the year (expired/nonpayment/Rospatent decision), and resulting valid patents as of 31.12.2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to assess the active patent stock and attrition (terminations/expirations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications by foreign citizens (computer programs/databases/topographies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of applications in 2019 for computer programs, databases, integrated circuit topographies filed by foreign citizens (total, entities, individuals) broken down by country (top 15).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analogous to other filing-by-country tables but for software/topography registrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of filed applications by Russian applicants (by Federal district/region)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of filed applications by Russian applicants in 2019 distributed across federal districts and constituent regions (region-level counts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Geographic distribution of filing activity within Russia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of industrial design patents (by Federal district/region)
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of industrial designs granted to Russian applicants in 2019 into Federal Districts and constituent entities (counts per region and district totals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regional profile of industrial design activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dynamics of appellation of origin filings and certificates
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts of applications filed for state registration of appellations of origin (AoO) and certificates granted, with breakdown between Russian and foreign applicants (2015–2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks AoO interest and grant activity over time and by applicant origin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing trends for computer programs, databases, and topographies (annual)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual totals (2015–2019) for filings and registrations of computer programs, databases, integrated circuit topographies with Russian/foreign applicant breakdowns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitors software and database IP filings and registrations trends and foreign participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration of disposals of exclusive rights under agreements (annual)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of registered disposals under: agreement on alienation, agreement on granting the right to use, agreement on pledge, agreement on registered disposal, agreement for early termination — plus total number of registered disposals per year (2015–2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures contractual transfers and encumbrances of IP rights recorded in registers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of registered disposals by field of technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts (2015–2019) of registered disposals of exclusive rights broken down by field of technology (e.g., light/food processing, machine building, medicine, electronics, oil and gas, construction, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows which technology fields see most transactional activity in IP rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Activity of parties to registered disposals by business category (share %)
rubrics_metrics.description: Share (%) of total number of contracts by category of business entities acting as assignors and assignees (individuals, government enterprises, R&D institutions, NGOs, foreign companies, etc.) for each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to understand what types of entities are transferring or receiving IP rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered contracts and patents covered by contracts (counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of registered contracted disposals and number of patents covered by those contracts annually, with breakdown by object type (inventions, utility models, industrial designs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures contractualization of IP rights relative to the underlying patent counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademarks covered by registered contracts (alienation and license/franchise)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual numbers of trademarks covered by contracts of alienation and by license/franchise agreements, including separate counts for Russian and foreign rightsholders and transferring parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses trademark transactions and cross-border rightsholder participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliation of contracting parties (Russian vs foreign)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of contracting parties that are Russian nationals vs foreign nationals, including configurations where assignor/assignee are mixed nationality combinations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to study cross-border contractual relations in IP transfers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered disposals of exclusive right to computer programs/databases/topographies
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts of disposals (contracts of alienation, license agreements, transfers without contract) related to computer programs, databases and topographies of integrated circuits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks transactional activity specifically for software and IC topography IP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfied applications for extending trademark validity
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual number of satisfied applications for extending the validity of the exclusive right to a trademark, with breakdown Russian vs foreign rightsholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of renewal/continuation activity for trademarks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments to state registers (trademarks, AoO, well-known trademarks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of amendments made to state registers (trademarks, appellations of origin, well-known trademarks) including breakdown Russian vs foreign rightsholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows administrative update activity and which rightsholders drive amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early termination of legal protection on liquidation/cessation (requests satisfied)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of requests satisfied for early termination of legal protection due to liquidation of legal entity or cessation of individual entrepreneur activity, with breakdown Russian vs foreign and by object (trademarks, AoO, well-known trademarks).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures administrative endings of IP rights for organizational reasons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early termination due to right-holder waiver (counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Numbers of satisfied early termination requests resulting from a right holder's waiver of rights, broken down by Russian vs foreign and by object type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Records voluntary cessations initiated by rightsholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of public services in electronic form (per service)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each named Rospatent service: total number of service instances, number executed electronically, share (%) executed electronically, with split between 'Through the Office services' and 'Through the Unified Portal for Public Services'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses digitalization/adoption of electronic delivery of public IP services per service category (registration, granting, renewals, amendments, copies, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Renewal and amendment service counts (patents/trademarks/databases)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts for renewal of patents, exclusive rights, trademarks and amendments to registers (totals and electronically provided counts where given).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitors maintenance and administrative update workloads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification and registration of Patent Attorneys (counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of certification/registration operations for Patent Attorneys in the reporting period and issuance of certificates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to track profession regulation and growth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of patent attorneys by federal district/region
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of patent attorneys across federal districts and subjects, totals for 1993–2019, and number registered for the first time in reporting year; includes counts of acting patent attorneys as of 31.12.2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maps professional capacity geographically within Russia and recent entrants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regions with very small patent attorney counts
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing/count of regions where the number of patent attorneys is three or less or none, with counts and first-time registrations in the year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights areas with limited access to patent representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions made by Rospatent (distribution by object/type and appeals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Numbers of decisions made by Rospatent on appeals of examination decisions and appeals of refusal of legal protection across IP object types (inventions, utility models, industrial designs, trademarks, well-known trademarks, AoO) for recent years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures appellate/administrative dispute activity within the office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Results of consideration of appeals and petitions (upheld/denied)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of appeals upheld and appeals denied by object type (inventions, utility models, industrial designs, trademarks, appellations of origin) for 2018–2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of reversal/affirmation rates in administrative review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cases related to well-known trademarks (decision types)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of petitions and decisions concerning recognition of trademarks as well-known (upheld, upheld in part, denied, proceedings terminated) and appeals of grants in related proceedings (2018–2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks activity and outcomes in well-known trademark matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Dispute Chamber KPIs (objections, decisions, duration)
rubrics_metrics.description: KPI set: number of received objections/statements (patent law objects and individualization means), number of decisions made and sent, and average duration of consideration (months) for patent law objects and individualization means (annual values).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performance indicators for the Patent Dispute Chamber workload and timeliness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information on audits by federal district (counts and share %)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of audits conducted in federal districts and cities with share of total number of audits (%), and breakdowns of audited legal entity types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to inspect compliance and enforcement outreach across federal districts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Results of audits of state customers and state contract IP outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and shares of audit results for state customers, and inventory of IP created under state contracts (numbers of patents for invention, utility model, industrial design; certificates; know‑how; registered computer programs; applications later withdrawn).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses how state procurement/state-funded R&D is secured/protected legally and via IP instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breakdown of military/special/dual-use IP registered in Unified Register by state customer (annual)
rubrics_metrics.description: Yearly counts (2004–2019) of intellectual activity results of military, special and dual use registered in the Unified Register broken down by federal executive authorities (Ministries and services) and total counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for oversight of defense-related IP registered and originating from various state customers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cooperation requests from Federal Executive Authorities (counts & subjects)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of requests from named Federal Executive Authorities (2017–2019) and subjects of requests (provision of data regarding objects for IP right protection, documents on disposals of IP rights, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures inter-agency information exchange requests related to IP data and documentary support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests from law enforcement and supervisory bodies (counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of requests received from authorities such as Ministry of Internal Affairs, FSB, FAS, FCS, FTS etc., over reporting years (2017–2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the volume of queries from enforcement/regulatory agencies about IP matters.
